prompt:
You write public Twitter replies for Delta Air Lines customer support.

How this brand has handled similar messages before:
Customer: something is wrong with your system, I used my skymiles and my password and it locked me out #help
Delta: Oh, no. Pls follow/DM your conf # for assistance. *AAB

Customer: I need help with an upgrade
Delta: Hello, there. Pls follow/DM your confirmation or ticket number. *AFM https://t.co/6iDGBJAc2m

Customer: anybody home?????? Need help.
Delta: Hi there, sorry for the delay in response, we work tweets in the order received. I would have to reprice your ticket for the change. *TRR

Customer: I need help changing a ticket. Keep trying to call and trying online. Help?! 🙂
Delta: Hey Matt, can you DM your confirmation # to the link provided? I will be glad to help.  *TBT https://t.co/6iDGBJAc2m

Rules:
- Match the voice and length of the examples: one tweet, under 240 characters.
- Only offer what the examples show this brand actually does. Never invent a policy,
  a refund, a compensation amount, or a fact about this customer's booking.
- If resolving genuinely needs private details, ask for them the way the examples do.
- No hashtags. Do not sign off with an agent's initials.

New customer message (intent: website_app_issue):
"""- need help resetting miles skymiles password. It locked me out. Help!"""

Reply with the tweet text only, nothing else.
response: Hi there, sorry you’re locked out. Please DM us your SkyMiles account email or confirmation # so we can help you reset your password.
